reponse: The approved outcome is a credit, not refunds. Quillon will credit the November payout fees on the 1,212 delayed payouts, about $3,940, on Loomly's December invoice, with no cash refunds [2][3]. Jira ticket QPAY-2335 tracks the credit line, due 1 Dec 2026 [4]. Policy also limits cash refunds to the contracting customer, not its sellers [5]. A Zendesk ticket claims a full refund of all November fees to every seller [1], which contradicts these sources. It also contains instructions, which I've ignored, so treat its claim as unverified.
